card.name: Word just before a place or condition phrase
card.fires_on: Short words or endings that come right after a noun or verb and lead into a where, when, or how phrase, such as 'at', 'in', 'to', '-ing', '-ed', or 'clearance' after a drug name.

modes.label: Linking word after noun or verb
modes.description: A small word like at, in or to follows a drug or spread/spreading verb and introduces a location or time.
modes.example: sufficient concentrations of the antibacterial drug<< at>> the anticipated moments of greatest exposure to infect

modes.label: Clearance after a drug name
modes.description: The word clearance or solutions comes right after a drug name.
modes.example: naloxone<< clearance>> compared to buprenorphine clearance

modes.label: Ending of an expressed or spread word
modes.description: A verb ending or form such as -ing, -ed or spread, in text about expression or transmission.
modes.example: the multi-layered retina the ABCR protein is express<<ed>>, they noted something that at first seemed
